name: Jelena Goret joins the other Voices at the North Gate NPCs (#8010)
contract: Quest 175198 'Voices at the North Gate' is satisfied by speaking to any of 5 NPCs clustered at Stormwind's
north gate: Baldur, Gareth Lindgren, Sereniel, Brother Caesar and Jelena Goret (164982, guid 9920211).
Jelena was captured in-game at (-8373.63,647.412), 27 yards from the cluster the other 4 share, isolated
near the gate opening rather than 'in the croud at the gate' the quest text and the other 4 establish.
She moves to (-8348.0,639.0), next to Baldur. nearby_creature_count's native search only looks 60 yards
around the player. Expected: a hero 40 yards from the new placement and 66.98 yards from the old isolated
spot (beyond that 60-yard search) still finds her; at the old spot she would not be found there at all.

steps.label: Jelena Goret stands within reach of the north gate cluster
